planned.name: sveltekit-workspace
planned.steps:
COPY . /app
RUN npm i -g pnpm@12.21.0 --ignore-scripts && pnpm --filter test-node-basic... --filter kit-monorepo install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm -F @sveltejs/kit prepublishOnly && pnpm -F test-node-basic build && test -f packages/adapter-node/test/apps/basic/build/index.js
planned.reference_scope: root lock plus explicit upstream Kit prepublish preparation; local apps and catalog

planned.name: actual-budget
planned.steps:
COPY . /app
RUN corepack enable && yarn install --immutable && yarn build:server && test -f packages/sync-server/build/app.js
RUN cd packages/sync-server && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const db=new(require('better-sqlite3'))(':memory:'); if(db.prepare('select 1 as value').get().value!==1) process.exit(1)"
planned.reference_scope: reference uses upstream Yarn scripts for native install; standalone native SQLite query, not server persistence or bank integrations

planned.name: flask-admin
planned.steps:
COPY --from=tool /uv /usr/local/bin/uv
COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app/examples/forms_files_images
RUN if test -f uv.lock; then uv sync --locked; else uv sync; fi && uv run --no-sync python -c "import flask, flask_admin; from PIL import Image; assert Image.new('RGB',(2,2)).size==(2,2)"
planned.reference_scope: dependency smoke only; documented example uses development server; upload not tested

planned.name: spring-jpa
planned.steps:
COPY complete/ /app
RUN sh gradlew --no-daemon test bootJar && test -n "$(find build/libs -name '*.jar' -print -quit)"
RUN java -jar $(find build/libs -name '*.jar' ! -name '*-plain.jar' -print -quit) > /tmp/jpa.log && grep -q 'Customer' /tmp/jpa.log

planned.name: symfony-demo
planned.steps:
COPY --from=tool /usr/bin/composer /usr/local/bin/composer
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip libicu-dev libonig-dev libsqlite3-dev && docker-php-ext-install intl mbstring pdo_sqlite
COPY . /app
ENV COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 APP_ENV=prod
RUN composer install --no-dev --no-interaction --no-scripts && php bin/console list --no-interaction
planned.reference_scope: Composer and console boot only; no seeded Doctrine runtime
